description: Search the signed-in person's items by text, list, category, or location. Archived items stay hidden unless list_type is archived. Results are paged. Only items the person owns or has lent out have a current_value. A wishlist item has target_price instead. Gifts the person plans to give are a separate list: they are returned only with list_type gift, which can be narrowed by recipient and gift_status (idea, bought, given). A gift has recipient, occasion, gift_date and gift_status, and no value: its current_value is always null. Every item also has display_value, the per-unit value that totals count: current_value when set, otherwise estimated_value, otherwise null. value_layer says which: confirmed (a value the person typed or accepted), market (a recent sold-listings value they have not accepted), estimate (worked out from the price paid and the purchase date) or none (no value yet).

gift_status.description: Gift list only: idea, bought or given. Needs list_type gift

list_type.description: Limit to one list. Omit to hide archived items and gifts. Gifts are returned only with list_type gift

q.description: Text matched against name, brand, model, category, description, notes, location, purchased from, lent to, borrowed from, tag names, and the name and description of collections the item is in. Everyday synonyms and singular or plural forms also match

recipient.description: Gift list only: who the gift is for. The whole name, in any letter case. Needs list_type gift

name: search_items
title: Search items
